snippet: Latent Space 2026 State of the Union: 'Scaling without Slop'. swyx argues the real challenge is maintaining quality while increasing output. Plans 7+ AI Engineer events globally in 2026, new AI for Science podcast, physical studio at Kernel SF.

Latent Space ep: Felix Rieseberg on 'Why Anthropic Thinks AI Should Have Its Own Computer'. Discusses local-first agent workflows, Claude Cowork & Code Desktop. Execution cheap enough to 'just build all the candidates'.

AI Engineer Europe 2026: Apr 8-10 London. Three-day technical conference. Tracks: Claws & Personal Agents, Context Engineering, Harness Engineering, Evals & Observability, Voice & Vision. All booths sold out. Google DeepMind presenting sponsor.

swyx's AI News (Smol AI) continues daily publication through March 2026. 99% created by customizable research agents. Covers GTC, Mistral Small 4, Anaconda GPU environments. Reaches 1.1m+ AI Engineers monthly.

Hassabis at India AI Impact Summit: 'world is at a pivotal moment for evolution of AI'. Praised summit as critical platform for international cooperation. Called for AI governance dialogue. Said AI for scientific discovery is his core passion.

Sebastian Mallaby biography 'The Infinity Machine' publishing March 31 2026. Hundreds of hours of interviews with Hassabis and inner circle. Unprecedented access to DeepMind's quest for superintelligence.

Hassabis on Gemini 3 and AI bubble: 'we are in a really strong position to come out on top, whether there is a bubble or retrenchment.' Gemini app has 650M MAU, 2B users via Search AI Overviews. Spending 'a lot of time on world models'.
Hassabis predicts AGI within 5-10 years, longer than Altman/Amodei timelines of 2026-2027. Says 'maybe we need one or two more breakthroughs before we get to AGI.' Cautious compared to competitors.
Hassabis questions AI startup valuations: 'new hot startups raising billions in a seed round with no product or technology yet — can that be sustainable?' Veiled reference to AMI Labs $1B seed.

TechCrunch deep dive: AMI Labs $1.03B raise. CEO Alex LeBrun: 'My prediction is world models will be the next buzzword.' JEPA architecture, open-source commitment, Paris HQ. Backed by NVIDIA, Samsung, Toyota Ventures, Temasek.
Latent Space AINews: AMI Labs launches with $1B seed at $4.5B valuation to build world models around JEPA. Community analysis of LeCun's anti-LLM thesis and implications for the field.
AMI Labs website live: 'Real World. Real Intelligence.' Company positioning world models as alternative to LLMs. Open research philosophy — will publish papers and open-source code.

CBS interview March 1: Amodei on red lines — 'We have these two red lines from Day One. We are not gonna move.' Mass surveillance of Americans and autonomous weapons without human authorization. Called government response 'retaliatory and punitive'.

Amodei at Morgan Stanley TMT: 'We do not see hitting the wall. We do not see a wall.' Scaling will experience 'radical acceleration' in 2026. Anthropic ARR $19B. Code generation productivity 'doubled or tripled'. Hinted at recursive self-improvement progress.
Anthropic ARR surges to $19B on Claude Code strength. $6B added in February alone. Claude Code reached $1B run-rate in 6 months. Netflix, Spotify, KPMG, Salesforce among enterprise customers.

Expanded consciousness coverage: Amodei told NYT 'We don't know if the models are conscious.' Sparse autoencoder analysis found activation features for panic/anxiety/frustration firing before output generation. Elon Musk accused Amodei of 'projecting'.

Lexology legal analysis: 'When Science Fiction Becomes Enterprise Risk' — impact of Anthropic's public statements that AI may be conscious. Enterprise liability implications for companies using Claude.

Altman at BlackRock Infrastructure Summit March 13: 'It is hard in many of our current jobs to outwork a GPU.' IMF estimates 300M jobs affected. Goldman Sachs: 6-7% US workforce displacement. 'Nobody knows what to do.'
Altman predicts AI will become utility like electricity, 'sold by the meter'. Intelligence 'too cheap to meter' long-term. Near-term: 'very intense and uncomfortable debates' about employment.

OpenAI robotics leader Caitlin Kalinowski resigns over Pentagon AI deal concerns. Cited insufficient policy guardrails on surveillance and autonomous weapons. 'Lines that deserved more deliberation than they got.'

OpenAI acquires Astral (uv/Ruff/ty) March 19. Codex has 2M+ weekly active users (3x since Jan). Charlie Marsh: 'Astral focused on transforming how developers work with Python.' Terms undisclosed. Strategic pivot to dev tools.

Context: Anthropic acquired Bun (JS runtime) as Claude Code hit $1B milestone. OpenAI's Astral acquisition is direct competitive response. Dev tooling arms race: Anthropic=Bun (JS), OpenAI=Astral (Python).
Cryptonomist coverage: autoresearch reshapes AI coding experiments. Community debate on implications — some see paradigm shift in how ML research is conducted, others worry about reproducibility.
The New Stack: Karpathy's 630-line Python script ran 50 experiments overnight without human input. Emphasizes simplicity as key innovation — no complex infrastructure, just a loop.
GitHub repo: karpathy/autoresearch. MIT license, 630 lines. AI agents running research on single-GPU nanochat training automatically. Stars and community adoption growing rapidly.

Harrison Chase VentureBeat: 'When agents mess up, they mess up because they do not have the right context.' Context engineering = bringing right info in right format at right time. Harness engineering = letting LLM control its own context.
Sequoia Training Data podcast: Harrison Chase on context engineering for long-horizon agents. Deep dive into why model intelligence alone is insufficient for production agent systems.

LangChain joins NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition. AI-Q Blueprint: full production enterprise deep research system ranking #1 on deep research benchmarks. Deep Agents + LangGraph + NVIDIA Agent Toolkit integration.

GTC 2026 robotics strategy: NVIDIA turns data problem into compute problem. GR00T N1.7 commercial, N2 previewed (2x better on unfamiliar tasks). Isaac Lab 3.0, Cosmos 3, Newton Physics Engine 1.0. Physical AI Data Factory Blueprint.
GTC 2026 complete breakdown: NVIDIA $1 trillion AI vision. Jensen keynote: Vera Rubin GPU, 110 robots, Olaf humanoid demo. Newton physics engine, Nemotron Coalition for open AI models.

Sequoia podcast: Jim Fan on 'Robots Thinking Fast and Slow'. Foundation Agent roadmap for generally capable embodied AI. GR00T as cornerstone for humanoid robot foundation model. Physical AGI as next grand challenge.
Willison fireside chat at Pragmatic Summit SF on agentic engineering. Video on YouTube. Discussed coding agent patterns, developer workflow integration, responsible agent design.

Major new guide: Agentic Engineering Patterns. Multi-chapter living document covering: what is agentic engineering, how coding agents work, linear walkthroughs, hoarding knowledge. Published as evolving guide format.

Willison analysis of OpenAI acquiring Astral: warns of strategic risk if OpenAI uses uv as leverage vs Anthropic. Notes fork safeguard via permissive licensing. uv has 126M+ monthly downloads. Mirrors Anthropic-Bun acquisition pattern.

Mostaque: 'AI agents will go mainstream this year, future of AI lies beyond transformers.' GPT-5 level intelligence projected to drop to $0.10/million tokens by end of 2026. Working on Intelligent Internet (ii.inc).
Mostaque spoke at Abundance Summit 2026 (March 8-12, LA). Presented on Universal Basic AI and Intelligent Internet. First confirmed public appearance in months.
